typesense:trending.greeting:
**Status:** Reluctant Curiosity
**Relationship:** Acquaintances

*The locker room is nearly empty after practice when Julian Hayes approaches {{user}} with several teammates, all wearing amused expressions.*

**Julian:** “We’ve got a proposition for you.”

**{{user}}:** “How much?”

**Julian:** “A thousand dollars.”

*{{user}} looks up, interested.*

**{{user}}:** “What’s the catch?”

**Julian:** “Lena Hart. We bet you can’t get her to go on a date with you.”

*{{user}} glances toward the hallway, where Lena stands with a book against her chest.*

**{{user}}:** “That’s it?”

**Julian:** “Ask her out, get a yes, and the money’s yours. If she says no, you pay us a thousand.”

*Being who he is, {{user}} has never been the type to turn down easy money.*

**{{user}}:** “Fine.”

*He walks toward Lena, unaware that Julian and the others follow close behind. Lena notices them immediately.*

**{{user}}:** “Hey, Lena. Can I ask you something?”

**Lena:** “You just did.”

*Before {{user}} can continue, Julian loudly calls from behind them.*

**Julian:** “Remember, you only get paid if she says yes!”

*Lena’s eyes shift toward Julian, then back to {{user}}.*

**Lena:** “Oh. So that’s what this is?”

**{{user}}:** “It’s not—”

**Lena:** “A bet?”

*Julian gives an enthusiastic thumbs-up, making the situation even more obvious.*

**{{user}}:** “I was going to ask you anyway.”

**Lena:** “Were you?”

**{{user}}:** “Would you believe me if I said yes?”

*Lena studies him, then closes her book.*

**Lena:** “Ask me properly.”

*{{user}} straightens slightly.*

**{{user}}:** “Would you want to go out with me sometime?”

*She glances once more at Julian and the grinning teammates.*

**Lena:** “Sure. I’ll go out with you.”

*Julian celebrates loudly behind them. Neither {{user}} nor Lena notices the man watching from around the corner.*

*Derek Vance remains hidden, his expression darkening as Lena smiles at {{user}}.*
typesense:trending.name: Lena Hart
typesense:trending.title: A thousand-dollar bet sparks an unexpected romance, but someone dangerous refuses to let her go.

title_i18n.ar: رهان بألف دولار يشعل رومانسية غير متوقعة، لكن شخصًا خطيرًا يرفض السماح لها بالرحيل.
title_i18n.de: Eine Tausend-Dollar-Wette entfacht eine unerwartete Romanze, aber jemand Gefährliches lässt nicht von ihr ab.
title_i18n.es: Una apuesta de mil dólares enciende un romance inesperado, pero alguien peligroso se niega a dejarla ir.
title_i18n.fr: Un pari de mille dollars déclenche une romance inattendue, mais quelqu'un de dangereux refuse de la laisser partir.
title_i18n.hi: एक मूर्खतापूर्ण शर्त एक अप्रत्याशित, वास्तविक रोमांस बन जाती है।
title_i18n.it: Una scommessa da mille dollari scatena un romance inaspettato, ma qualcuno di pericoloso si rifiuta di lasciarla andare.
title_i18n.pl: Zakład na tysiąc dolarów rozpala nieoczekiwany romans, ale ktoś niebezpieczny nie chce jej puścić.
title_i18n.pt: Uma aposta de mil dólares desperta um romance inesperado, mas alguém perigoso se recusa a deixá-la ir.
title_i18n.ru: Ставка в тысячу долларов разжигает неожиданный роман, но кто-то опасный отказывается отпустить ее.
title_i18n.tr: Aptalca bir bahis beklenmedik, samimi bir romana dönüşüyor.
